name: pagebutler
description: Build plain HTML websites with Claude Code and host them on butler.page. Every change is a preview first, and goes live only when you ask. Needs a PageButler account.

monitors.name: comments
monitors.command: command -v pb >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; PAGEBUTLER_NO_UPGRADE=1 exec pb comments watch
monitors.description: Comments you send your agent on PageButler previews
